identity.name: Tejas Prabhu
identity.tagline: Software engineer at NetApp, building full-stack tooling and asynchronous Python infrastructure for enterprise storage systems.

summary: I build software for enterprise storage systems at NetApp — full-stack internal applications with FastAPI and Vue, LLM-powered developer tooling that turns unstructured system output into something engineers can act on, and asynchronous Python frameworks that drive high-concurrency workloads across multi-cluster storage environments.

My background is in the systems software that makes large-scale storage verifiable. At Seagate I built the frameworks and CI infrastructure other engineers depended on to ship firmware safely. At the North Carolina Institute for Climate Studies I built ETL pipelines on AWS for large-scale geospatial climate data, cutting processing time by 60%.
I work best where requirements shift and shipping something usable this week matters more than a perfect design next quarter.

outlook: Software engineering at the intersection of storage and cloud infrastructure and AI-powered developer tooling. Depth in distributed systems over breadth across frameworks. Open to collaborating on infrastructure and developer tooling projects.

highlights.label: Full-stack platform tooling
highlights.text: Build internal applications with FastAPI and Vue — API design through to UI — used by engineering teams for platform operations and reporting.

highlights.label: LLM developer tooling
highlights.text: Build retrieval pipelines and agents that turn unstructured system output into usable signal for debugging and root-cause work.

highlights.label: Asynchronous Python at scale
highlights.text: Architect async frameworks that drive high-concurrency workloads across distributed multi-cluster storage environments.

highlights.label: Fault injection
highlights.text: Design systems that model node failures, control-plane outages, network partitions and storage-layer faults — deliberately breaking clusters to find what real failures would.

highlights.label: Distributed systems debugging
highlights.text: Work across the control and data plane at system level, surfacing race conditions, consistency issues and performance bottlenecks.
